page_title: DOR 0-4 BAY | Dortmund v Bayern Munich 04/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+3' 0 - 4 Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) bursts into the box after a great solo run and gets one-on-one with the keeper, who he neatly side steps and rolls the ball into an empty net. Wonderful effort!
90+1' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
90+1' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul after Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
89' Here is a change. Leroy Sane is going off and Thomas Tuchel gives the last tactical orders to Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich).
89' Substitution. Jamal Musiala leaves the pitch and is replaced by Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich).
87' CHANCE! Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
87' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) perfectly wins the ball from the free kick, but his effort from the edge of the penalty area isn't accurate enough and the ball goes a few inches over the bar!
85' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
83' The ball is cleared after Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
81' Marco Reus (Dortmund) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
80' Deniz Aytekin blows the whistle, Sebastien Haller (Dortmund) is penalised for a foul.
79' Substitution. Sebastien Haller (Dortmund) has come on for Niclas Fullkrug.
79' This shall not pass! Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
78' Niklas Sule (Dortmund) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
77' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) tackles a bit over-zealously and Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul.
76' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
76' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
75' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
74' Deniz Aytekin shows a yellow card to Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) for his blatant foul.
72' 0 - 3 Goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) scores after an assist by Kingsley Coman that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 0:3.
70' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
68' Marco Reus (Dortmund) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
68' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Felix Nmecha (Dortmund), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
67' The substitution has been made. Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) has replaced Julian Brandt.
66' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) commits a foul during an attacking move.
65' A cross from Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
65' He should have done better. Marco Reus (Dortmund) is afforded space to connect with a Marcel Sabitzer cross, but his header from the centre of the box flies well over the crossbar.
64' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. If it wasn't for Gregor Kobel's superb save the ball would have probably ended up inside the left post.
63' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
61' Mats Hummels (Dortmund) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Deniz Aytekin had an easy-decision to make.
60' Thomas Tuchel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) replacing Dayot Upamecano.
59' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund).

59' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) rifles a low drive from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic reflex save.
57' Edin Terzic decides to make a substitution. Donyell Malen will be replaced by Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund).
57' That's the end of the game for Salih Ozcan, who is replaced by Felix Nmecha (Dortmund).

57' Marco Reus (Dortmund) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the right post, but Manuel Neuer shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
55' Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle and it's Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
55' Salih Ozcan (Dortmund) sends a long cross over to Julian Ryerson, but Manuel Neuer comes forward to gather the ball.
54' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
53' The resulting corner from Julian Brandt (Dortmund) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
53' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player. The ball goes out of play. Dortmund are awarded a corner kick.

52' A through ball from Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) fails to reach Harry Kane as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Harry Kane could have got into a promising position.

50' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Marco Reus was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
48' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) has a goal ruled out for offside!

47' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
47' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) goes for goal and shoots towards the left side of the goal, but his effort is well blocked.
47' Bayern Munich will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
46' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
46' Half-time substitution. Marius Wolf (Dortmund) is replaced by Niklas Sule.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Donyell Malen (Dortmund) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just over the bar.
45+1' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
43' Thomas Tuchel (Bayern Munich) gets a yellow card, off the field.

43' Salih Ozcan (Dortmund) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Deniz Aytekin with no other option than to blow for a foul.
41' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
40' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) attempts to release Leroy Sane with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
39' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
39' Salih Ozcan (Dortmund) makes a strong challenge and Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul.

38' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) wins some space for himself around the penalty spot and manages to produce a promising header. One of the defenders stops his effort before it gets to the goalkeeper, making him redundant.
37' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes a snap shot from outside the box. His effort curls way wide of the left post.
36' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
35' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
34' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
32' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
32' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) received a precise low pass and immediately unleashed a shot on goal. Unfortunately, he only found the left post.
31' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) sends a long ball forward to Donyell Malen, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
30' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
29' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
28' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
27' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) tries to find Leroy Sane, but he puts too much power on the pass.
27' The ball rebounds to Marco Reus (Dortmund) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar.
26' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
25' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
25' Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle and signals a foul after Salih Ozcan (Dortmund) brought his opponent down.
24' Kingsley Coman nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
23' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball into the stands. Nice run, but poor finish!
22' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
21' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul.
20' The ball is behind the sideline. Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) takes a throw-in.
19' A pass by Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
17' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
16' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
15' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
15' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
14' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked.
13' Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) plays a terrific long ball forward to Kingsley Coman, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
13' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies well wide of the right post.
11' Mats Hummels (Dortmund) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The linesman signals a throw-in for Bayern Munich.
9' 0 - 2 Goal! Leroy Sane feeds Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 0:2.
9' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
8' Marco Reus (Dortmund) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
8' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
7' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball is out of play. Bayern Munich will have a throw-in.
7' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) receives a reproachful look from Jamal Musiala. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails well wide of the left post.
6' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
4' 0 - 1 The corner from Leroy Sane goes into a dangerous area and finds Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich), who outjumps the defence and glances a header into the back of the net. 0:1.
4' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
3' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayern Munich.
3' Bayern Munich are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
2' Marco Reus (Dortmund) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Bayern Munich will have the kick-off.
Deniz Aytekin will supervise the game today.
